blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every country has labour laws. These laws protect workers and companies. They say how many hours you can work, how much rest you need, and how much you must be paid.

Every company must follow these rules. HR helps the company to understand and to respect these laws.

Doing things the right way is called compliance. When a company follows the rules, workers are safe and the company has no problems.

items.q: What do labour laws protect?
items.why: "These laws protect workers and companies."

items.q: Who helps the company to understand these laws?
items.why: "HR helps the company to understand and to respect these laws."

items.q: What is compliance?
items.why: "Doing things the right way is called compliance."

items.q: The text suggests that a company that does NOT follow the rules will probably…
items.why: Inferência: se seguir as regras deixa tudo seguro e sem problemas, não seguir traz problemas.

items.q: The author would most likely say that following labour laws is…
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que "every company must follow these rules".

blocks.instruction: Ouça Charlotte falando com os novos gerentes. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, everyone. Welcome to the team. Today I want to talk about the main rules you must follow at work.

First, hours. Workers must not work more than the legal hours. If a person is tired, the work is not safe. So please, watch the hours of your team.

Second, money. We must pay every employee on time. We pay on the same day every month. This is very important. People need their money to live.

Third, rest. Every worker needs rest. You must give your team time to rest during the day. A short break helps people to work well.

And one more thing. You must not share private data about the employees. Their information is secret. Only HR can see it.

These rules are different in each country. But the idea is always the same: we do things the right way. If you have a question, come to me. I am here to help you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the first rule Charlotte talks about?
items.why: "First, hours. Workers must not work more than the legal hours."

items.q: When must the company pay the employees?
options: At the end of the year
items.why: "We must pay every employee on time."

items.q: Who can see the private data of the employees?
items.why: "Only HR can see it."

items.q: Why does Charlotte say a tired worker is a problem?
options: Because they need a new contract
Because tired workers ask for more money
Because the work is not safe
items.why: Inferência: "If a person is tired, the work is not safe."

items.q: How would you describe Charlotte in this talk?
items.why: Inferência: ela explica as regras com calma e diz "I am here to help you".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Every worker needs some rest during the day." Rest means…
items.why: Rest = descanso, tempo para relaxar.

items.q: "The company must protect its workers." To protect means to…
items.why: To protect = proteger, manter em segurança.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We must ___ the employees on time every month."
items.why: To pay = pagar; pagamos os funcionários em dia.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Every company must ___ the labour laws."
items.why: To follow = seguir; seguir as leis trabalhistas.

items.q: "Doing things the right way is called compliance." Compliance means…
items.why: Compliance = conformidade, fazer as coisas do jeito certo, seguindo as regras.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões sobre regras e RH. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager must sign off on the new contract." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new rules next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = colocar em prática, começar a usar.

items.q: "Please check with HR before you sign." To check with someone means to…
items.why: Check with = consultar, perguntar antes de agir.

items.q: "Two managers pushed back on the new plan." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar.

items.q: "We must keep up with the labour laws in every country." To keep up with means to…
items.why: Keep up with = acompanhar, ficar por dentro.
